## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `sap-s4hana-ce-salesorder-0001-setup-guid`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create a communication user

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your SAP S/4HANA Cloud tenant as a system administrator. -->
2. Open the **Communication Management** app and select **Maintain Communication Users**.
3. Select **New** to create a new communication user.
4. <!-- manual: Enter a User Name (e.g., SALES_ORDER_API_USER) and a Description. -->
5. <!-- manual: Set a secure Password and confirm it. -->
6. Select **Create**.

## Step 3: Create a communication system

1. In the **Communication Management** app, select **Communication Systems**.
2. Select **New** and enter a **System ID** (e.g., `BALLERINA_INTEGRATION`) and a **System Name**.
3. <!-- manual: Select New and enter a System ID (e.g., BALLERINA_INTEGRATION) and a System Name. -->
4. <!-- manual: Under Technical Data, set the Host Name to the hostname of your integration system. -->
5. Under **Users for Inbound Communication**, select **+** to add the communication user you created in the previous step.
6. Select **Save**.

## Step 4: Create a communication arrangement for sales order integration

1. In the **Communication Management** app, select **Communication Arrangements**.
2. Select **New**.
3. In the **Scenario** field, search for and select **Sales Order Integration (SAP_COM_0109)**.
4. <!-- manual: Enter an Arrangement Name (e.g., BALLERINA_SALES_ORDER). -->
5. <!-- manual: Select the communication system you created in the previous step under Communication System. -->
6. Confirm the inbound communication user is assigned under **Inbound Communication**.
7. Select **Save**.
8. After saving, the arrangement details page displays the **API URL**; this is your SAP S/4HANA hostname for the connector (format: `‹unique-id›-api.s4hana.cloud.sap`).
